script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

*BELLA*, a 30-something artist, sits in a corner, painting a scene on her canvas.

WAITRESS
(cheerily)
Morning, Bella! What a beautiful day.

BELLA
(graciously)
Morning, Jessica. The day is certainly bright.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - LATER

*JASON*, a man in his late 30s, enters the coffee shop. He spots Bella in the corner.

JASON
(whispers to himself, smirking)
Well, well, well. If it isn't Bella, the elusive artist.

BELLA
(looks up, surprised)
Jason? Is that you?

JASON
(laughs)
Yes, it's me. Jason, your long-lost... friend.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - SEATING AREA

Bella and Jason sit down to catch up.

BELLA
I can't believe it's been years since we last spoke. How have you been?

JASON
(chuckles)
I've been good. Traveling the world, living life to the fullest. But I've missed our little chats.

BELLA
(sighs)
I've missed them too. I've been focusing on my art, trying to make a living.

JASON
Well, you've certainly come a long way, Bella. I'd love to see your latest work.

INT. ART GALLERY - DAY

Bella and Jason tour Bella's art gallery.

JASON
(whispers, impressed)
You've really made a name for yourself.

BELLA
(modestly)
Thank you, Jason. I couldn't have done it without your support.

INT. PARK - DAY

Bella and Jason sit on a bench in the park, surrounded by nature.

BELLA
You know, Jason, I've always wondered what might have happened if we had pursued something more between us.

JASON
(pauses, then smiles)
It's a question that's crossed my mind as well. But I believe that every experience, good or bad, leads us to where we're meant to be.

BELLA
That's a beautiful perspective. I'm just grateful for our reconnection.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - NIGHT

Bella and Jason sit in the coffee shop, sipping their drinks.

JASON
I'd like to offer you an opportunity, Bella. A chance to collaborate on a project I'm working on. It could be a game-changer for your career.

BELLA
(hesitates)
I'd be honored, Jason. But I must warn you, I don't collaborate easily.

JASON
(laughs)
That's what makes it all the more exciting. Let's do this.

INT. ART STUDIO - DAY

Bella and Jason work together in Bella's art studio, brainstorming ideas.

BELLA
(excited)
I think I have an idea!

JASON
(encouragingly)
Let's hear it.

BELLA
(presents her idea)

JASON
(impressed)
That's brilliant, Bella! I think this collaboration could be something special.

INT. GALLERY OPENING - NIGHT

Bella and Jason's collaborative art piece is showcased in a gallery opening. The crowd is impressed, and Bella's career reaches new heights.

BELLA
(smiling at Jason)
I couldn't have done it without you.

JASON
(smiling back)
And I couldn't have asked for a better collaborator.

FADE OUT.

End of screenplay.
